# bugs #3172: --std-sdccXX: a variable argument of the form (unsigned char)*p is promoted to int

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3172/
- Category: [Fixes that need a decision](../../fix-decision.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Close together with #3674 when its patch is applied.
- Patch: [bugs-3674.patch](../../patches/bugs-3674.patch), commit [`046244906`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/0462449066c91c3f6cc9a3ce72556a0f7e30a296). Applies to r17176 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The test for this ticket, `support/regression/tests/bug-3172.c.in` from r12023, has its assertions
inside `#if 0` in trunk. With the assertions enabled it fails on mcs51. Under
`#pragma std_sdcc99`, `(unsigned char)(*p1)` is passed as an `int`, while the same cast on a
literal or on a variable passes one byte. The struct members that the last comment reads through a
pointer are the same case.

Since SDCC 4.5.15, only mcs51, ds390, mos6502, mos65c02, pic14, and pic16 omit the promotion. For
the other ports, among them the port of the report, `processParms` in trunk promotes every
variable argument that is narrower than `int`, with or without a cast. The mixture of sizes in the
ticket cannot occur there. This follows from the code and was not run for the port of the report.

## Cause

`decorateType` in `src/SDCCast.c` removes casts to the type that the operand already has and sets
`removedCast` in the node of the operand. `processParms` reads that flag only for symbols. For a
pointer dereference, an array element, or a member access, the tree has no cast, and
`processParms` promotes the argument. This explains the observation in the seventh comment that
the casts are absent from the AST dump.

## Fix

The patch for bug #3674 makes `processParms` read `removedCast` on every argument node. It also
enables the assertions of `bug-3172.c.in` for the six ports that omit the promotion, and it makes
the test assert `int` for all other ports.

## Decision

The entry for bug #3674 states the choice that the patch makes and the ports on which it was not
tested.

## Verification

Without the change to `SDCCast.c`, `bug-3172.c.in` fails on mcs51. With it, the test passes on the
host, the six mcs51 variants, stm8, and ucz80. ds390, mos6502, mos65c02, pic14, and pic16 were not
built.

## Related

Bug #3674 reports the same defect for function calls. Its entry describes the patch.
